_meta.doc: A/B experiment registry. Loaded by static/js/experiments.js. Each experiment has an id, status (active|paused|draft), and variants whose traffic must sum to 100. Bucketing is deterministic on (te_uid, experiment_id) — same user always gets the same variant for a given experiment, but bucketing across experiments is independent.
_meta.schema: see static/js/experiments.js for full schema docstring

experiments.doc: First real experiment: an A/A test (both variants do the same thing). Sole purpose is to validate the end-to-end harness — bucketing → tracker.js event.exp → worker events.experiments column → analyze_experiments.py — by checking that traffic actually splits ~50/50. If the split is off, something in the pipeline is broken. Per the audit's A7 implementation order: 'no-op A/A test (control vs control)' lands first, before any treatment-vs-control experiment touches the ranker. Run analyze_experiments.py after a few days; expect impressions and clicks roughly equal across variants. Audit ref: §4.A7 step 1.
